title.zh: 将八打雁省八打雁市镇的塔伦波克村分为该市镇名为塔伦波克西朗岸与塔伦波克坎卢兰的两个村的法案
title.en: An Act Dividing the Barrio of Talumpoc, Municipality of Batangas, Province of Batangas, into Two Barrios to be Known as the Barrios of Talumpoc Silangan and Talumpoc Kanluran of Said Municipality
title.orig: An Act Dividing the Barrio of Talumpoc, Municipality of Batangas, Province of Batangas, into Two Barrios to be Known as the Barrios of Talumpoc Silangan and Talumpoc Kanluran of Said Municipality

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1957/ra_1669_1957.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en:
The barrio of Talumpoc, Municipality of Batangas, Province of Batangas, is divided into two barrios to be known as follows:
Barrio of Talumpoc Silangan, which shall be constituted by the sitios of Romano, Poyesan, Bondeo and Latag; and Barrio of Talumpoc Kanluran, which shall be constituted by the sitios of Ginto, Duhatan, Kulingkang, Piit and Cuaba.
The boundaries of the two barrios shall be Bilogo Bridge at the north end, the barrio school building and the Bondoc ñg Sapangan at the center, and Munting Bondoc at the south end.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 20, 1957.
